parameters.packNote: One call returned 64 candidates (review object 85f952e0-857d-4aef-af1d-5a2b50eef805, tagged heat, weapon, rejected); the owner picked 0, the pickaxe, and 13, the felling axe, from a numbered sheet at 3x. Every pickaxe came out as asked, grip at the lower left; every axe came out mirrored, its head up and to the left and its grip at the lower right. The pack's 10 generations are counted once, here.

icon.from: the object's one rotation; also the weapon's icon in the inventory

swing.animationDescription: a swing: the pickaxe turns about the bottom end of its handle, which stays in place, from pointing up and to the right, through pointing straight ahead to the right, to pointing down and to the right; the same pickaxe the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail

endFrame.from: icon.png turned a right angle clockwise (lossless), so the head points down and to the right; passed as end_frame_base64
